flags.sentence: A multidisciplinary team (MDT) meeting is recorded for 0.5% (95% CI 0.2–1.5; n=3/591) of patients in Kymenlaakson hyvinvointialue compared with 6.0% (893/14873) nationally, with the 95% confidence interval excluding the national value, though this figure measures recording practice rather than care because specialist procedures enter HILMO only from direct patient contacts.
flags.problem: Omits the caveat from [cty:mdt_recorded:Kymenlaakson_hyvinvointialue] that the share is crude (not age- or stage-adjusted).

flags.sentence: With no treatment record within 12 months at 16.4% (95% CI 13.7–19.6; n=97/591) versus 27.5% (4089/14873) nationally, treatment recording in Kymenlaakson hyvinvointialue looks relatively complete.
flags.problem: Overreaches beyond the cited claims: having a lower share with no treatment record does not establish that treatment recording is relatively complete because the measure mixes untreated patients and unrecorded treatment, and the sentence omits the caveat that the share is crude.

flags.sentence: Because treatment recording already looks relatively complete at 16.4% (95% CI 13.7–19.6; n=97/591) with no treatment record within 12 months versus 27.5% (4089/14873) nationally, local data-quality work should focus on auditing stage completeness and standardising MDT coding—currently at 0.5% (95% CI 0.2–1.5; n=3/591) versus 6.0% (893/14873) nationally—as the Filha programme calls for uniform recording instructions and the national roadmap plans coding practices and a cancer quality register with 90% data coverage including stage.
flags.problem: Overreaches by stating that treatment recording looks relatively complete from the 12-month no-treatment-record share alone (which mixes untreated patients and unrecorded treatment), and omits the caveat that both the no-treatment-record and MDT shares are crude (not age- or stage-adjusted).
